validation.core_tests: not executed by this runner; require separate pytest evidence
validation.release_gate_scope: predeclared numeric metrics only; independent holdout, core regression, and real services require separate acceptance
validation.claim: 离线人工响应/向量回放仅验证工程逻辑，真实提取和语义质量尚未验收。

config.ingestion_policy: ingest every split source into seeds-only actual ledger before any query; gold retrieval ledger is separate
config.extraction_scoring: whole fact set including trusted source/project/observation, effective time, type, correction target; exact source substring independently audited
config.query_scoring: ranked key + top1 status/value + exact source-ID set + every cited ledger event valid
config.zero_denominator_policy: null/N/A; lack of positive samples does not satisfy a numeric release gate
config.semantic_claim_boundary: recorded vectors and lexical search cannot establish real embedding quality
